ladder.teaches: top k with a heap of size k
ladder.why: A min-heap of the k largest so far keeps the kth largest at its root, in O(n log k).

ladder.teaches: top k with a heap of size k
ladder.why: Top k by a key: count first, then a size-k heap whose ordering includes the tie-break rule.

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Pop the two smallest, push their sum: the merged item must re-enter the order, which is why a heap and not one sort.
The next output is the smallest of k heads, so a heap of heads gives each step in O(log k).

ladder.teaches: two heaps for a running median
ladder.why: A max-heap of the lower half and a min-heap of the upper half put the median at the tops after every add.

ladder.teaches: a heap of events or end times (scheduling)
ladder.why: Process trips by departure and reuse the earliest-free bus at the origin: a min-heap of end times (per station).

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Amazon OA: buy the globally cheapest next unit m times, popping a type and pushing back its next price.

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Each sale takes the type with the most stock and pushes it back with one less: a max-heap simulation in a story.

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Halve the current heaviest each day: the greedy choice is obvious once you see a max-heap gives it.

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Amazon OA: the heaviest package goes to the truck with most capacity, whose halved capacity goes back into the heap.

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Most frequent letter first, holding the last letter out for one step: a heap with a cooldown.

ladder.teaches: repeatedly take the best and push back the rest (simulate)
ladder.why: Decide late: keep passed stations in a max-heap and refuel from the best only when stuck.
